channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Emaar India Appoints Rahul Taneja as Chief Marketing Officer
item.description: Emaar India has appointed Rahul Taneja as Chief Marketing Officer, tasking him with leading brand positioning, project launches and marketing-sales alignment across India.

item.title: Indian Super Gaming League Announced as India’s First Franchise-Based National Esports Competition
item.description: India has announced the launch of the Indian Super Gaming League, a franchise-based national esports competition featuring eight teams and a multi-city qualifier circuit ahead of its inaugural season.

item.title: Over 10,000 Runners Mark 10th Edition of ‘Run for a Girl Child’ at Gachibowli Stadium
item.description: More than 10,000 participants took part in the 10th edition of ‘Run for a Girl Child’, marking a decade of impact on over 35,000 girls from underprivileged communities.

item.title: CREDAI Convenes 7th Edition of YouthCon in Bengaluru, Bringing Together Next-Generation Industry Leaders
item.description: Over 500 young developers gathered in Bengaluru for the 7th edition of CREDAI YouthCon, where the body announced a global trade MoU and reinforced its sustainability commitments.

item.title: MAHA HOLI Set for Grand Hyderabad Debut at Mindspace SOCIAL
item.description: MAHA HOLI will make its Hyderabad debut on March 1 at Mindspace SOCIAL, featuring Shor Bazaar Live, DJ sets and a large-scale open-air Holi celebration.

item.title: Goa Tourism Concludes Strong Participation at SATTE 2026 With Robust Industry Engagement
item.description: Goa Tourism concluded its participation at SATTE 2026 with strong industry engagement, showcasing its Regenerative Tourism roadmap and strengthening trade partnerships.

item.title: EEMA Hosts Webinar on Recognising Red Flags and Strengthening Artiste Safety
item.description: EEMA conducted a webinar on recognising red flags, promoting workplace safety and reinforcing artistes’ rights, as part of its ongoing efforts to build a safer and more inclusive events industry.

item.title: Indian Event Leaders Drive Global Touring Conversations at ILMC 38
item.description: The 38th edition of the International Live Music Conference (ILMC) concluded in London from 24 to 27 February 2026, once again bringing together the most influential stakeholders in the global touring and live entertainment ecosystem. item.title: George P. Johnson Delivers Xiaomi 2026 New Product Launch Ahead of MWC Barcelona
item.description: George P. Johnson delivered Xiaomi’s 2026 product launch in Barcelona ahead of MWC, mobilizing a cross-functional team across time zones to execute the global event.

item.title: Wizcraft Entertainment Agency Launches “Talent For All (TFA)” Global Talent Sourcing and Booking Division
item.description: Wizcraft Entertainment Agency has launched Talent For All (TFA), a new global division focused on talent sourcing, booking and cross-industry collaborations across entertainment and live experiences.
